title: ICAO Aircraft Engine Emissions Databank
publisher: ICAO, hosted by the European Union Aviation Safety Agency (EASA)
licence: © European Union Aviation Safety Agency. "Reproduction is authorised, provided the source is acknowledged, save where otherwise stated." (https://www.easa.europa.eu/copyright-disclaimer)
notes: One row per databank UID, taken from worksheet "Gaseous Emissions and Smoke"; nvPM columns joined by UID from worksheet "nvPM Emissions" (null where the engine has no nvPM entry).
Modes are the ICAO Annex 16 Vol II LTO points: TO = take-off (100 % rated thrust), CO = climb-out (85 %), App = approach (30 %), Idle (7 %). Sea-level static, ISA, uninstalled.

Units: fuel flow kg/s; emission indices g per kg fuel; nvPM EImass mg/kg, nvPM EInum particles/kg (engine exit plane, not system-loss corrected); noxDpFoo = characteristic NOx Dp/Foo g/kN; noxLTO g and fuelLTO kg per LTO cycle; sn = smoke number.

engType: TF turbofan, MTF mixed turbofan. dataStatus: PR pre-regulation, C certification, R revised. superseded = 1 means a later UID (supersededBy) replaces the row; filter superseded = 0 for current data. engineStatus: OOP out of production, OOS out of service, null in production.
Numeric values rounded to 4 significant figures (5 for rated thrust and LTO NOx mass).
